'''''Koh-Lanta: Viêtnam''''' is the twelfth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''.

[[Philippe Duron]] defeated [[Claude Dartois]] in a 6-1 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].

== Production ==
This season took place in the Côn Đảo archipelago in Vietnam.

==Twists==
* '''[[Battle of the Sexes]]:''' For the second time, the castaways are divided into [[tribe]]s based on gender, but following a Day 1 twist, one woman would be a part of the men's tribe and one man would be a part of the women's tribe.
*'''False Day 1 Eliminations:''' Before the marooning, Denis Brogniart told the tribes that one man and one woman would not join the sixteen other castaways on the boat. Believing it was an elimination, [[Boris Deltell]] and [[Véronique Bègue]] volunteered to sacrifice themselves. However, they were later told that they were not eliminated and would each be transported to the opposite gender's tribe [[camp]].
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:''' On Day 8, a Tribe Switch occurred where two castaways, one man and one woman, would be named captains. The captains would start a [[Schoolyard Pick]] and alternating picking castaways of the opposite gender until two new tribes of eight were created.
* '''Return:''' Due to two [[Evacuation|evacuations]] and a [[quit]], three castaways ([[Virginie Mercadal Pioli]], [[Marine Plissonneau]] and [[Aurélie Gasser]]) re-entered the game.
